((CASE
		WHEN mi.type = 'series' THEN (
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM episodes
			WHERE episodes.series_id = mi.content_id
			  AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = episodes.content_id
	)
		)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM episodes
			WHERE episodes.series_id = mi.content_id
			  AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = episodes.content_id
	)
			  AND NOT (
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_progress uwp
			WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
			  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwp.media_item_id = episodes.content_id
			  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				  AND uwp.updated_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)
		OR EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_history uwh
			WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
			  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwh.media_item_id = episodes.content_id
			  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				  AND uwh.watched_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)
	)
		)
	)
		WHEN mi.type = 'season' THEN (
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM episodes
			WHERE episodes.season_id = mi.content_id
			  AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = episodes.content_id
	)
		)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM episodes
			WHERE episodes.season_id = mi.content_id
			  AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = episodes.content_id
	)
			  AND NOT (
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_progress uwp
			WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
			  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwp.media_item_id = episodes.content_id
			  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				  AND uwp.updated_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)
		OR EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_history uwh
			WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
			  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwh.media_item_id = episodes.content_id
			  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				  AND uwh.watched_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)
	)
		)
	)
		WHEN mi.type = 'ebook' THEN EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM ebook_reader_progress erp
		WHERE erp.user_id = $1
		  AND erp.profile_id = $2
		  AND erp.content_id = mi.content_id
		  AND erp.progress >= 0.9
		  AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
			WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
			  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
			  AND hhi.media_item_id = erp.content_id
			  AND erp.updated_at <= hhi.hidden_before
		  )
	)
		ELSE (
		EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_progress uwp
			WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
			  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwp.media_item_id = mi.content_id
			  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				  AND uwp.updated_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)
		OR EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM user_watch_history uwh
			WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
			  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
			  AND uwh.media_item_id = mi.content_id
			  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM user_history_hidden_items hhi
				WHERE hhi.user_id = $1
				  AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				  AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				  AND uwh.watched_at <= hhi.hidden_before
			  )
		)

(EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM media_files mf
		WHERE mf.content_id = mi.content_id
		  AND mf.missing_since IS NULL
		  AND CASE LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(mf.resolution), ''))
		WHEN '4k' THEN '2160p'
		WHEN 'uhd' THEN '2160p'
		ELSE LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(mf.resolution), ''))
	END = $1
		  AND mf.hdr = $2
		  AND mf.bitrate >= $3 AND mf.bitrate <= $4
		  AND mf.audio_language_codes @> ARRAY[$5]::text[]
		  AND (
			mf.subtitle_language_codes @> ARRAY[$6]::text[]
			OR EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(mf.external_subtitles, '[]'::jsonb)) AS track
				WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(track->>'language', '')) = $6
			)
		)
		  AND NOT (EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(mf.video_tracks, '[]'::jsonb)) AS vt
			WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(vt->>'dolby_vision'), '') IS NOT NULL
		))
	))
